page.missionStatement: Carolina Minted Collectibles' mission is to build lasting value for collectors and investors by strategically acquiring, curating, and trading high-grade Pokémon and sports collectibles. We focus on assets with long-term growth potential, navigating market dynamics to secure scarcity and capitalize on opportunities for future generations.
page.storyBody: Carolina Minted Collectibles was founded in 2025 with a clear vision: to build lasting value for collectors and investors by strategically acquiring, curating, and trading premium trading cards. What started as a passion for the hobby has evolved into a thriving business focused on high-grade Pokémon, sports collectibles, and Star Wars Unlimited trading cards. Based in Gastonia, North Carolina, we combine market expertise with a deep appreciation for the collectibles that connect generations of fans and players.
page.lookingAheadBody: We're expanding our operations to better serve the collecting community. In 2026, we'll be launching enhanced retail operations, including an e-commerce platform and in-person sales opportunities. We're also growing our Star Wars Unlimited selection, with a focus on limited, serialized cards that present compelling opportunities for future appreciation.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Common questions about our vault, shipping, and grading standards.

items.question: How do you ensure the authenticity of your cards?
items.answer: We take authenticity seriously. Our raw inventory is inspected by experts, and our graded cards are exclusively from top-tier services like PSA, BGS, and SGC. We stand behind every item we sell.

items.question: What is your shipping policy?
items.answer: We treat every package like a grail. Slabs are sleeved and bubble-wrapped; raw cards are secured in top loaders and team bags. All orders are shipped in sturdy boxes to prevent damage during transit.

items.question: Do you accept returns?
items.answer: Due to the volatile nature of the collectibles market, all sales on graded cards and sealed wax are final. However, if there is an error with your order, please contact us immediately so we can make it right.

items.question: Can I sell my collection to Carolina Minted?
items.answer: Yes! We are always looking to acquire high-grade vintage sports and modern TCG collections. Use our Contact page to send us a list or photos of what you're looking to sell.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Currently, we only ship within the United States. We are working on expanding our logistics to serve the global collecting community in the near future.
